lines.1: --And before I knew it, it was time for our date.
lines.3: 「Oh yeah, you stopped by the drama club first, right?」
lines.4: 「Yeah, I had some props to get ready and stuff. Then I came straight here.」
lines.5: So that's why she was in uniform.
lines.9: 「She's at the martial-arts club today. She said she has student-council work afterward too.」
lines.10: 「Oh, then it's just the two of us, Tsushima. Right... Kurogane-senpai isn't here, after all.」
lines.11: Oh man, my heart was already starting to pound.
lines.12: 「Oh, and don't go into Otome's room just because she isn't here, okay?」
lines.15: 「This is my second time in your room, Tsushima.」
lines.16: We sat close together on the bed.
lines.17: 「Wait, why are we on the bed already!?」
lines.18: 「I just thought sitting on the floor would be weird, so we sat here instead.」
lines.22: 「Hmm... I'm not in the mood for that right now.」
lines.25: That leaves me with no options!
lines.26: 「Then what do you want to do!?」
lines.27: 「You can at least think of something yourself, Tsushima. Honestly, you're so inconsiderate.」
lines.28: Somehow, I was the one who ended up getting scolded.
lines.30: You can't get anywhere in life if all you do is shoot down ideas.
